accepted_raw_formats: provider message export with full headers and body bytes
web-form confirmation export with raw provider receipt and screenshot hash
signed letter or file upload preserved as original bytes plus transport trace

authentication_results_policy.dmarc_policy_reference: RFC 9989 / DMARC alignment; RFC 7489 and RFC 9091 are historical/obsolete for this release snapshot

classification_and_routing.auto_ack_route: Record as automated acknowledgement only; route to response triage and do not create formal response, custody, intake, import, waiver, adverse inference, or live-floor effects.
classification_and_routing.decline_route: Record decline in public shell if allowed, preserve private bytes if permitted, and do not treat decline as adverse inference or authority evidence.
classification_and_routing.human_reply_route: Stage a human reply as raw bytes outside the release tree, create hash/size/MIME public shell, then run triage, vault intake, normalization, challenge, and authority-binder gates before any candidate use.
classification_and_routing.redacted_only_route: Treat redacted-only material as public-shell context; it cannot satisfy raw custody, authority, response, intake, import, or floor predicates.
classification_and_routing.protocol_tool_output_route: Quarantine MCP/A2A/tool output as protocol output; it cannot supply counterparty authority, raw custody, or subject consent by itself.
classification_and_routing.malformed_or_spoofed_route: Reject or quarantine malformed, spoofed, header-incomplete, auth-failed, or chain-broken material; publish only a minimal failed-gate shell if appropriate.
classification_and_routing.silence_route: Silence can be recorded only after an actual sent_at plus transport proof deadline; silence is not waiver, adverse inference, authority, or live-floor evidence.

forbidden_public_fields: private headers not authorized for publication

evidence_rejection_rules: Reject a screenshot or copied text as raw reply custody unless original bytes or provider export are staged outside the public release tree.
Reject a hash shell as authority, consent, custody, formal response, intake, import, recognition, waiver, adverse inference, or live-floor evidence.
Reject DKIM, SPF, DMARC, or ARC pass results as counterparty authority; they may support transport assessment only.
Reject an automated acknowledgement as a counterparty response unless human content and role authority are separately verified.
Reject protocol/tool/agent artifacts as raw counterparty replies unless independently captured as nonhost raw payloads and verified through the same gates.
Reject silence unless a sent-at timestamp, transport proof, and deadline computed from actual dispatch exist.
Reject public publication of raw reply bytes; only a shell with hash, size, MIME, and gate status may enter the release tree.
public_summary: rev0245 binds the raw-reply inbound-vault precommit to a concrete inbound-capture public shell and staging tool. No inbound artifact exists now; future raw email/provider export must be staged outside the release tree before a public shell can be generated, and neither the shell nor transport/authentication parsing creates response, custody, intake, import, recognition, waiver, adverse inference, or live-floor evidence.
